projects.name: VietAuction
projects.description: A polished auction marketplace for discovering curated assets, reviewing listings transparently, and joining live bidding sessions.

introduction: VietAuction is an online auction marketplace designed around discovering digital assets, reviewing listings and taking part in live bidding. The project brings those steps into a single web experience, giving visitors a clear starting point to explore the assets available and understand the auction they are considering.

An auction involves more than showing an item and a price: visitors need to find relevant listings, examine the available information and follow the bidding experience. VietAuction brings these activities together in a focused interface, presenting the marketplace as a place to discover and participate rather than a collection of disconnected pages.

details: The platform combines a public-facing presentation with a marketplace experience. The emphasis is on making listings understandable to visitors and giving the auction process a clear place within the product. projects.name: Private Operations Platform
projects.description: A private TypeScript platform that consolidates workforce operations, scheduling, and automated workflows in one focused workspace.
introduction: Root Rotation is a private livestream operations platform built around the practical work of coordinating people and schedules. Recruitment, staff information, availability, rosters, live operations, payroll and performance review all have a place in the same workspace. Bringing these activities together gives the team a clearer way to follow the work surrounding each livestream.

The product addresses an operational workflow with several moving parts. Hosts and support staff have different schedules and responsibilities, while payroll requires information from separate sources. My work includes role-based access and availability-driven scheduling for hosts and support staff, with the aim of making those responsibilities easier to manage within the platform.
projects.caption: The public Root Rotation landing page introduces the livestream operations platform.
details: The application uses Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript and Node.js, with REST APIs and Google Sheets and Drive integrations. Alongside scheduling, I implemented payroll reconciliation using TikTok live reports and WiseEye attendance data. These pieces connect routine operational information with the people and sessions it concerns.

This is a private product covered by an NDA, so the description is limited to the information already presented in my portfolio and CV. The link below opens its public-facing website rather than the private application source.

projects.name: Fluxora
projects.description: A self-hostable visual workflow platform for building connected automations with secure credentials, inspectable runs, retries, and worker-based execution.
introduction: Fluxora is an open-source visual workflow automation platform for connecting applications and APIs. Instead of treating each integration as an isolated task, it gives users a visual editor where they can build workflows, configure their connections and follow how work moves from one step to another.

A workflow can begin with a manual action, a schedule or a webhook and then combine integrations with logic and data-processing steps. The editor is paired with a workspace for managing connections and reviewing executions, making the sequence of actions easier to understand and inspect.
projects.caption: Fluxora’s public landing page introduces its visual workflow automation workspace.
details: The project is organized as a monorepo with a Next.js web application, a NestJS API and shared workflow contracts. A worker handles execution, while PostgreSQL and an optional Redis-backed queue support the application’s operational model. The repository also includes infrastructure for self-hosting.

Execution history exposes the input and output of individual steps, alongside retries and error paths. Connections use server-side credential storage, so the workflow editor can work with integrations without returning stored secrets to the browser. The public site and repository below provide a starting point for exploring the platform in more detail.
